question: Which government agency released the draft Registration of Consumer Organisations (Amendment) Regulations on 14 September 2023?

options.text: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI)** released the draft **Registration of Consumer Organisations (Amendment) Regulations** on **14 September 2023**.
 
• TRAI is a statutory body established by the **Government of India** under the **Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997**.
 
• The primary role of TRAI is to regulate the telecommunications sector in India, ensuring the interests of consumers and promoting fair competition.
 
• TRAI also issues regulations, directions, and recommendations concerning telecommunication services and tariffs.
 
• The draft regulations aim to enhance the role and functioning of consumer organizations in the telecom sector, ensuring better consumer protection and advocacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**__

 __
 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** is a statutory body formed under the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999**.
 
• Its primary purpose is to regulate and promote the insurance and re-insurance industries in India.
 
 
 
• **Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI)**__
 __
 
• The **Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI)** is a self-regulatory voluntary organization of the advertising industry in India.
 
• It aims to ensure the protection of the interests of consumers by promoting responsible advertising.
 
 
 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)**__
 
 
• The **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)** is the regulatory body for securities and commodity markets in India.
 
• It was established in 1988 and given statutory powers through the **SEBI Act, 1992**.
 
• SEBI's primary function is to protect the interests of investors in securities and to promote the development and regulation of the securities market.
